name: Webserver
description: Serve multiple websites directly from the RMM: each under rmm.url.de/<name>, with its own folder (editable in the app, in the Explorer/relay under "Websites" and via a network drive) and its own permissions for users and groups. Also serves as the hosting base for the deployment server. Websites can also be forwards (reverse proxy, e.g. for Docker containers).
